title: Checking an Eye
intro: An empty point may look protected while the stones around it can still be captured. Check the groups holding the boundary.

steps.instruction: You are White. Try playing in Black's apparent eye.
steps.hint: One of the three stones around that eye is not attached to the others, and it is standing on one liberty.
steps.explanation: The move captures a black stone at the boundary. That capture makes the move legal.

steps.instruction: Play as Black. Fill the gap to connect the loose stone.
steps.hint: The eye point itself. Yes, really.
steps.explanation: The stones are connected. You have used the empty point, so it cannot be counted as an eye.

steps.instruction: The loose stone is now connected. Try the White move again.
steps.hint: Play the eye. The game will stop you.
steps.explanation: No black stones are captured this time. White would have no liberty, so the move is refused.

outro: Check whether the stones protecting an eye can be captured. An empty point alone does not prove a group is alive.
